claimed_scope: Build the minimal Frankenstein-2.0 causal identity spine for session_id, agent_id, task_id, turn_id, causal_id and generation, with explicit parentage, stable validation and deterministic serialization. This work defines identity semantics only; it does not create a second state authority, perform effects, migrate live UnifiedDB data, access the VPS, or claim integrated runtime/GRID10/HCU/EntityOS acceptance.
dependencies: F2-WP-100 UnifiedDB resolver/fingerprint interface (parallel dependency; no overlap)
non_overlap_note: F2-WP-100 was already claimed by another organ before this write. A refreshed repository search returned no F2-WP-101 claim. This claim therefore advances the next causal-coordination package without modifying F2-WP-100.
identity_invariants: generation is a non-negative integer and is never inferred from wall-clock time
causal_id names causal lineage, not transport/admission identity
turn_id is scoped by session_id and agent_id rather than treated as globally unique by accident
task_id may persist across turns and sessions only when explicitly carried
unknown or malformed required identifiers fail closed
deterministic serialization must not depend on dictionary insertion order
acceptance_target: typed identity object covers session_id, agent_id, task_id, turn_id, causal_id and generation
validation rejects empty identifiers, booleans masquerading as integer generations, negative generations and unexpected fields
canonical JSON serialization is deterministic for equivalent identity values
child/derived identities can carry explicit parent_causal_id without silently changing the root causal_id
unit tests cover valid construction, malformed input, deterministic serialization and generation changes
source/local deterministic tests never mint VPS or whole-system runtime credit
next_exact_action: Implement the minimal typed causal identity primitive and deterministic unit tests in the canonical F2 repository, run local deterministic tests only, then archive the bounded source/test result.
